title: Quentin and the Room
author: Beatrix Iversen
blurb: Sable Ravensworth, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
